title: Binance Futures Launches VIP Starter Pack: Zero Maker Fees and Liquidity Provider Trial Perks for New Futures Traders
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, As Binance conducts regular reviews of its programs to provide users with the most value and competitive services, Binance is excited to introduce the Futures VIP Starter Pack — a tiered incentive program designed to help new users grow their Futures volume with clear milestones and valuable benefits. The Futures VIP Starter Pack enables users to start trading Futures with lower initial costs, enhanced trading capabilities, and a transparent path to scale their trading activity and improve their overall experience. Key Highlights: Enjoy zero maker fees and increased order/message rate limits; Unlock milestone rewards at $50,000,000 and $100,000,000 monthly Futures volume, including maker rebates and a 4-week trial in the  USDⓈ-Margined Futures Liquidity Provider Program ; Access  Low-Latency API services. The three stages of the Starter Pack are as follows: Stage Requirement 	 Benefits Stage 1 (Week 0-3) Submit an application and pass the review by the Futures Business Team. Zero USDⓈ-M Futures maker fees and 5 whitelisted IP quotas for the first 4 weeks Stage 2 (Week 4-7) Achieve $50,000,000 Futures monthly volume during Week 0-3 -0.001% on USDT-M Pairs -0.004% on USDC-M pairs  5,000 order rate limit or 5,000 message request limit per minute for additional 4 weeks Stage 3 (Week 8-11) Achieve $100,000,000 Futures monthly volume during Week 4-7 Eligibile to join the USDⓈ-Margined Futures Liquidity Provider Program Trial (4 weeks) When the applicants’ 30-day Futures volume reaches $100,000,000 at stage 3, they can join the  USDⓈ-Margined Futures Liquidity Provider Program  Trial for 4 weeks, which grants them: USDⓈ-Margined maker rebate: Maker rebates: -0.003% (USDT-M pairs), -0.006% (USDC-M pairs) 50 whitelisted IPs for users to access low-latency API services via both REST API and WebSocket API How to Participate: The Starter Pack is designed specifically for new Futures traders. Users should meet  all three criteria  in order to be eligible to participate: Registered their Binance accounts within the last 180 days; API trading ratio greater than 50%; Meet either trading volume criteria: Futures trading volume between $10,000,000 and $50,000,000 equivalent over a 30-day period, or Futures trading volume below $10,000,000 and Spot trading volume above $1,000,000 equivalent over a 30-day period. To apply for this program, please submit the  application form  or contact your sales or key account coverage team for assistance. Users who do not meet the above criteria can reach out to  futures-business@binance.com  to apply. We encourage users to attach additional information in the form to support their application. Upon successful application, the Futures Business Team will contact you with further details and tailored stage targets if needed. Important: If users fail to meet any stage requirements during their first participation, they are not qualified to join the program again within 6 months. Apply Now Notes: User Onboarding and Assessment Onboarding happens every Monday; assessment period for each stage starts from that stage’s first Monday to the fourth Sunday after onboarding. Fee Adjustment Period starts around 08:00 (UTC) on the first Monday after onboarding and ends on the fifth Monday for each stage respectively. Only users who meet requirements for each stage can progress to the next stage. Users who do not meet the requirement will be removed from the program. All trading volumes and metrics related to the Promotion are measured by Binance at its sole and absolute discretion. Self trades will be excluded from volume calculations. Binance reserves the right to, at its sole discretion, remove accounts from the Promotion. Binance reserves the right to amend or terminate this program at its sole discretion.
